configurePresets.name: x86
configurePresets.description: Builds only opengl32_enh32.dll + opengl32_enh32_test.exe (see CMakeLists.txt's CMAKE_SIZEOF_VOID_P branch and generators/gen_wrapper_cpp.py) - no TSLANG involved. The environment below stands in for vcvars32.bat so this configures without needing to be run from an x86 Native Tools prompt; bump the MSVC/SDK version strings here if the toolchain is updated.

environment.INCLUDE: C:\Program Files\Microsoft Visual Studio\18\Professional\VC\Tools\MSVC\14.51.36231\include;C:\Program Files (x86)\Windows Kits\10\Include\10.0.28000.0\ucrt;C:\Program Files (x86)\Windows Kits\10\Include\10.0.28000.0\um;C:\Program Files (x86)\Windows Kits\10\Include\10.0.28000.0\shared
environment.LIB: C:\Program Files\Microsoft Visual Studio\18\Professional\VC\Tools\MSVC\14.51.36231\lib\x86;C:\Program Files (x86)\Windows Kits\10\Lib\10.0.28000.0\um\x86;C:\Program Files (x86)\Windows Kits\10\Lib\10.0.28000.0\ucrt\x86

configurePresets.name: x86-release
configurePresets.displayName: x86 Release (Ninja, plain C++ proxy only)
configurePresets.description: Same target as 'x86' (opengl32_enh32.dll + tests), built optimized (/O2, NDEBUG, no /RTC1 runtime checks) instead of the debug config. Separate binaryDir so a Debug and a Release build can coexist without reconfiguring over each other.
